title_en: 2026 Multiple Major Essay Contest Organised by the Major Design Support Center
summary: The Major Design Support Center of the College of Liberal Studies is holding the 2026 Multiple Major Essay Contest, and participation is voluntary. Eligible current students in their third year or above (including students on leave of absence) and graduates who have multiple-major experience in this university's undergraduate program may apply and submit an essay through SNU비교과 (SNU Extracurricular) by Sunday, 22 November 2026.
applies_to: Voluntary (not mandatory). Open to enrolled students in their third year or above (including students on leave of absence) and to graduates, in each case only if they have multiple-major experience during this university's undergraduate program. Multiple majors are: double major, minor, interdisciplinary major (연합전공), linked major (연계전공) and student-designed major.

dates.what: Deadline for applying and submitting the essay through SNU비교과 (all participants)

conditions: Only students and graduates with multiple-major experience during this university's undergraduate program may enter.
Enrolled students must be in their third year or above; students on leave of absence are included.
Multiple majors means a double major, minor, interdisciplinary major, linked major or student-designed major.
Entries must be about the student's own undergraduate multiple-major experience.
Application and essay submission are made through SNU비교과 only, as stated in the notice.
steps: Log in to SNU비교과 (SNU Extracurricular) and find the contest post by searching for its title: 2026 다전공 수기 공모전: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 나의 다전공 이야기 (the notice also gives a direct link, which was not read).
Read the contest post on SNU비교과 and apply for the contest there.
Submit your essay through SNU비교과 by Sunday, 22 November 2026.
translation:
The Major Design Support Center of the College of Liberal Studies is holding the "2026 Multiple Major Essay Contest – My Multiple Major Story, One Thing Leading to Another" (2026 다전공 수기 공모전 - 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 나의 다전공 이야기).

We welcome stories of the questions, learning and growth you experienced while choosing and completing a multiple major. Interested students are encouraged to take part.

A. Contest overview

ο Theme: Undergraduate students' experience of completing a multiple major

ο Eligibility: Enrolled students in their third year or above (including students on leave of absence) and graduates who have multiple-major experience during this university's undergraduate program
※ Multiple major: double major, minor, interdisciplinary major (연합전공), linked major (연계전공), student-designed major

ο Submission deadline: Sunday, 22 November 2026

B. How to participate: Apply and submit your essay through SNU비교과 (SNU Extracurricular)
※ Direct link to the SNU비교과 post ▶ 2026 다전공 수기 공모전: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 나의 다전공 이야기 (the link itself was not read)
